sentences.text:
Gulam Mustafa & Ors vs Mahhoob Alam @ Munna & Anr on 13
June, 2023
13.06.2023
 Serial no.24
 Aloke
Ct. No. 30
 Crr 981 of 2020
 Gulam Mustafa & Ors.
 Vs.
 Mahhoob Alam @ Munna & Anr.
 Mr. Asis Bhattacharyya
 Mr. Biswajit Mitra
 ... for the petitioners

The present revisional application is moved by the
 learned counsel for the petitionerx praying for quashing of the
 Complaint Case no. 10 of 2020 under Sections 506/504/323 of
 the Indian Penal Code, pending before the learned 5th Judicial
 Magistrate, Sealdah, District 24 Parganas (South).

It is submitted that the petitioner no. 1 is   grandfather, petitioner no. 2 is the father and the petitioner no. 3  is the grandmother of the wife of the opposite party no.
 1/complainant.
A case under Section 498A of the Indian Penal  Code has been initiated by the wife of the opposite party no. 1.
It is submitted that the present case has been filed as a

. 
 It is further submitted that the petitioner no. 1 is more  than 80 years old and the present complaint has been filed with  mala fide intention.
Considering the materials on record, the present revision  is to be heard in presence of the opposite parties.

2  During pendency of the proceedings let there be a stay of the proceedings in Complaint Case No. 10 of 2020 under Section 506/504/323 of the Indian Penal Code, pending before the learned 5th Judicial Magistrate, Sealdah, District 24 Parganas (South).
Let the matter appear in the monthly list of July, 2023 for hearing.
(Shampa Dutt (Paul), J.)
